summary: This note describes a 2007 digital re-release of the album "Groovy Decay" by Yep Roc Records, sold exclusively as a download from the label's website. The release adds bonus tracks and demo versions of four album tracks previously issued on "Groovy Decoy". Only the demo of "Midnight Fish" from that earlier release is left out.
one_line: A 2007 Yep Roc Records digital-only remaster of the album "Groovy Decay" with bonus tracks and demos.
key_facts: In 2007, Yep Roc Records remastered "Groovy Decay".
The 2007 remaster was made available exclusively as a digital download on the Yep Roc Records website.
The download includes the bonus tracks "How Do You Work this Thing?", "It Was the Night", and "Falling Leaves".
The download includes demo versions of four of the album's tracks as previously issued on "Groovy Decoy".
The demo of "Midnight Fish" is the only "Groovy Decoy" track not included on the re-issue.
